I will probably even receive a few downvotes for suggesting this, but I really feel like it would improve the site a lot. The downvote button is there to keep the community involved in post moderation without burdening mods, I understand this. It should only be used on irrelevant or spam posts, I understand that as well. But here's the thing - even though we may limit how many downvotes a person can use we cannot limit how they use them. The community will downvote things they disagree with and this will make for a hive-mind.

I suggested this before and someone pointed out that it would make us more like facebook, which is simply untrue. Facebook does not rank its posts based on a score, Voat does.

As for community moderation, this can still work by using the report function. Reporting should obviously only be done when someone is spamming or posting illegal content. If someone is spamming or posting illegal content, downvoting will not help anything. As for off topic comments, simply not upvoting them will keep their rank low and thus irrelevant compared to quality posts.

I fail to see a single downside to removing the downvote button, but I see a lot of inevitable problems to keeping it, like this. The thing is, we're not Reddit, we do not need an exact Reddit clone simply run by more competent people, we should seek to be better than them.

Using the downvote button incorrectly is toxic, it tells the world that if someone's opinion conflicts with your own it should not be seen. This is the absolute antithesis of free speech - the only thing this place offers over Reddit.
